change.summary: The annex lists the commodities and products subject to the regulation. It also states that the regulation does not apply to goods made entirely from waste that has completed its lifecycle. Merchants must check if their goods fall under the listed codes and the waste exclusion rule.

obligations.text: Check if goods are listed as relevant commodities or products in the annex.
obligations.quote: The following table lists goods as classified in the Combined Nomenclature set out in Annex I to Regulation (EEC) No 2658/87 that are referred to in Article 1 of this Regulation.

obligations.text: Do not place on the market goods made entirely from waste that has completed its lifecycle.
obligations.quote: Except for by-products of a manufacturing process, where that process involved material that was not waste as defined in Article 3, point (1), of Directive 2008/98/EC, this Regulation does not apply to goods if they are produced entirely from material that has completed its lifecycle and would otherwise have been discarded as waste as defined in Article 3, point (1), of that Directive.

reasons: Applies because you sell wooden furniture and leather goods, both of which are covered by the regulation's list of commodities (wood and cattle products).
You are established in Germany and ship to multiple EU countries, so you place these goods on the EU market.
The regulation requires you to verify whether your specific products match the HS codes in Annex I and ensure they are not made entirely from waste that has completed its lifecycle.

todos.text: Compare your product catalogue against the HS codes in Annex I to confirm which items are in scope
todos.quote: The following table lists goods as classified in the Combined Nomenclature set out in Annex I to Regulation (EEC) No 2658/87 that are referred to in Article 1 of this Regulation.

todos.text: Ask your suppliers to confirm that your wooden and leather goods are not produced entirely from material that has completed its lifecycle and would otherwise be discarded as waste
todos.quote: Except for by-products of a manufacturing process, where that process involved material that was not waste as defined in Article 3, point (1), of Directive 2008/98/EC, this Regulation does not apply to goods if they are produced entirely from material that has completed its lifecycle and would otherwise have been discarded as waste as defined in Article 3, point (1), of that Directive.
